result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one major layout problem where the bottom navigation overlaps content, and one minor carousel clipping issue.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the restaurant list, cutting off the second 'Popular right now' card so its content is partially hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add enough bottom padding/spacing to the scrollable content or make the bottom bar non-overlapping so list items remain fully visible above it.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal row is clipped on the right edge, making the last card appear partially cut off.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel shows a clear peek of offscreen items or add more right-side spacing so the truncation looks intentional.
